sources.title: Acceptance Dynamics Across Cognitive Domains in Speculative Decoding
sources.snippet: A larger target model then verifies these tokens in a single batched forward pass. Despite the growing body of work on speculative methods, the degree to which the cognitive characteristics of a task affect acceptance probability remains largely unexplored. We present an empirical study of tree-based speculative decoding acceptance dynamics.
